'''October 2000 Modesto tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Modesto, CA on 7 October 2000. [[Kyle Ishimaru]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1307">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-07-modesto-10-7-00d1307/ modesto-10-7-00], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 7 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-07-modesto-10-7-00d1307/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Modesto, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kyle Ishimaru]]
